name: Stock State
query:
SELECT 
    sle.item_code,
    sle.warehouse,

    -- Sum of movements AFTER last zero
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN sle.posting_datetime > (
            IFNULL((
                SELECT z.posting_datetime
                FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` z
                WHERE z.actual_qty = 0
                AND z.item_code = sle.item_code
                AND z.warehouse = sle.warehouse
                ORDER BY z.posting_datetime DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ), 0))
            THEN sle.actual_qty
            ELSE 0
        END
    )
    +
    IFNULL((
        SELECT z.qty_after_transaction
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` z
        WHERE z.actual_qty = 0
        AND z.item_code = sle.item_code
        AND z.warehouse = sle.warehouse
        ORDER BY z.posting_datetime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ), 0) AS final_qty

FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
WHERE sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s
GROUP BY sle.item_code, sle.warehouse

name: Stock State Lightweight
query:
SELECT item_code, warehouse, final_qty
FROM (
    SELECT 
        item_code, 
        warehouse, 
        qty_after_transaction AS final_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_code, warehouse ORDER BY creation DESC, name DESC) as row_num
    FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
    WHERE warehouse = %(warehouse)s 
      AND is_cancelled = 0
) t
WHERE row_num = 1;
